title: Lending Fintech Startup Olyv Raises $6 Mn, Takes Series B To $30 Mn
summary: Lending fintech startup Olyv raises $6 million, bringing Series B total to $30 million
detailed: Olyv raised approximately $6 million (~₹57 crore) from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited and existing investors, extending its Series B round to $30 million.
Founded in 2016, the fintech platform offers Personal Loans, Gold Savings, and Credit Health management, serving nearly 2 million monthly active users across 19,000+ pin codes in India.
The company has disbursed ~80 lakh loans, facilitated ~Rs 13,000 crore in cumulative transactions, and targets 100 million users and $1 billion in AUM by FY29.
To date, Olyv has raised ~50 million in equity and ~150 million in debt from institutional backers including Fundamentum, SMBC Asia Rising Fund, Lightrock, and Nippon India.
sentences: Olyv, a credit-led fintech platform, has raised ~USD 6 million (~₹57 crore) from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited (hereinafter referred to as “Nippon India Alternative Investments”) along with existing investors, extending the total Series B funding round to ~USD 30 million.

With this investment, Nippon India Alternative Investments joins Olyv’s roster of marquee institutional investors, alongside existing investors Fundamentum and SMBC Asia Rising Fund, adding the strength of a leading global investment institution to its investor base.

The addition brings the backing of a leading global investment institution to Olyv’s investor base, further strengthening its institutional support as the company continues to scale its business and expand its offerings.
Olyv was founded in 2016 by Rohit Garg, Amit Chandel, Vinay Singh, and Jayant Upadhyay, and today offers products across Personal Loans, Gold Savings, and Credit Health management.
With nearly 2 million monthly active users and over 5 crore app downloads, Olyv serves customers across 19,000+ pin codes in India.
To date, Olyv has disbursed ~80 lakh loans and facilitated ~Rs 13,000 crore in cumulative transactions, while consistently increasing PAT profitability for 14 consecutive quarters.
By FY29, the company is targeting a user base of 100 million and AUM of over $1 billion.
Rohit Garg, Co-founder and CEO, Olyv, said, “We are delighted to welcome Nippon India Alternative Investments to Olyv’s investor base.
Their participation reflects the confidence that leading global institutions are placing in the opportunity we are building.

Since inception, the company has raised ~50 million in equity and ~150 million in debt, with investors including Fundamentum, SMBC Asia Rising Fund, Lightrock, Unicorn India Ventures, India SME, as well as reputed family offices, including Gauri Khan’s Family Office, and prominent entrepreneurs and sports personalities
